name: Paradise Call
source:
At a place where girls phone in, a guy waits. When a girl calls in, he talks with her. If he respond right, he will meet the girl and have fun. This game is a simpler version of Virtuacall 1.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
在一个接听女孩来电的地方，一名男子守在电话旁。女孩打来电话时，他便与对方交谈；只要应答得当，就能与女孩见面并共度欢乐时光。本作可视为《Virtuacall 1》的简化版。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
